reviews.title: Very nice unit
reviews.text: I have had this unit combined with the DVFE 5 ton air handler since October. I am in Central Florida and have used it in very cold (for Florida) and very hot weather. It is extremely quiet and my power usage is about 10 percent less than the same sized but higher SEER efficiency unit it replaced. I like it a lot. It keeps the house at a very constant and even temperature.  My only concern, which I believe is inherent in all communicating inverter systems is humidity control. Humidity tends to be about 54 percent while my old unit was around 48 percent. I have used all the different settings with no real change. Still, I highly recommend this unit and am very satisfied.

reviews.text:
Last week, Master Air replaced our 20‑year‑old 13 SEER single‑stage HVAC systems with two Daikin 16 SEER multi‑stage HVAC systems, and the difference is remarkable. The old units were loud, inefficient, and struggled in extreme temperatures. The new systems are much quieter, adjust output smoothly, and maintain consistent comfort while improving humidity control and reducing energy use.

Master Air impressed us. The installation crew was professional, respectful, and completed clean, high‑quality work in a single day. They clearly explained the process, answered all our questions, and ensured everything was optimized.

Both the Daikin equipment and Master Air’s service have been excellent. If you’re in Pearland or the Houston area, I highly recommend Master Air and their Daikin systems.

reviews.title: Good but certainly not perfect
reviews.text: The Daikin fit is more quiet than my two 2013 single stage units, but hardly silent and certainly a lot more noisy than say a refrigerator. The other issue Diakin One thermostat is slow to respond to finger taps and is a decade behind a thermostat like Ecobee. It really show activate when you approach it with a motion sensor and require a finger tap to wake it. The UI also has a very basic look ala 2016 technology and it does not have good integration with other smart devices or hubs like Home Assistant. I have the 2 ton and 4 ton units at my home and while they are fairly quiet I can still hear them from inside the bedroom because they are on the other side of the wall and you can hear them even when they are in 'quiet mode' late night. Overall the main benefit is going to be the good parts warranty. If you've moving from a single stage to an inverter be aware that the unit will be running pretty much all the time if you live in a hot climate and it doesn't shut off often. In summary it's a solid 4 star product however they should modernize that iPhone app and the design of the thermostat itself and bring it from 2016 to 2026 in both hardware and software.

reviews.title: High Quality
reviews.text:
After being without AC for far too long and waiting nearly two weeks just for a fan replacement on our old system, we decided it was time for a complete replacement. We chose Big Fish Cooling & Heating, and it was one of the best home service experiences we've had.

The owner personally called me on Memorial Day weekend, listened to our situation, and we had a plan in place within an hour. While we waited for installation, they even provided a temporary AC unit for our bedroom so we could sleep comfortably.

We had a Daikin DC6VS variable-speed 4-ton system installed with a Daikin One+ thermostat, and the difference is incredible. The house is cooler, quieter, and more comfortable than it has been in years. The humidity control alone has been a game changer. We slept better the very first night.

The installation team was professional, respectful of our home, and took the time to explain the system and thermostat features. The Daikin One+ thermostat is impressive, and the outdoor unit is so quiet that I can barely hear it from our bedroom window.

From the owner to the technicians, everyone treated us like people instead of just another service call. The communication, workmanship, and customer service were outstanding.

If you're looking for an HVAC company that truly cares about its customers, I highly recommend Big Fish Cooling & Heating.

— Kevin "The Golf Ball Guy"

reviews.text: I have installed Trane for over 21 years. Serviced many other brands. Always recommend Trane. I currently reside in Wilmington NC. The company I work for is a Trane dealer. The started installing some Daikin products. Our comfort advisor suggested I try a Daikin Fit. I was very sceptical. Trane is the bench mark and that from experience has always been my go to brand for customers. So, I figured why not try it. 12 year parts warranty. I am a proffesional HVAC service technician and installer. Pulled out a 28 year old system and installed the new Daikin Fit. Hands on seeing the system while installing, I approve the quality and fore thought that went in designing this product. So far I am very satisfied with this system. reviews.title: Wow! what an eye opener!
reviews.text: Our old Courier heat pump gave up after 10 years but the warranty only lasted 5 years. After considering a number of options we chose our new Daikin heat pump for its quiet running, 12 year warranty and efficiency. While we have only had it for a month, we were amazed that our weekly usage was down by 50%, the unit operated less frequently and was whisper quiet, both inside and outside. Best of all, it keeps circulating the air in the whole house constantly but kicks in the compressor when absolutely needed, maintaining a dew point of 55 to 60 degrees. What more could we ask for?

reviews.title: Quiet, Comfortable, and Great So Far
reviews.text:
We recently installed a Daikin Fit heat pump system and have been very happy with it so far. One of our initial concerns was whether the downstairs apartment and basement area would become too cold, but the temperature has been comfortable throughout the house.

The system runs very quietly and the overall comfort has improved significantly compared to our old setup. We also appreciate the smoother and more even airflow with the upgraded ductwork and return modifications.

We have not received our first electricity bill yet, but we are hopeful that the improved efficiency will help reduce our energy costs over time. We also appreciated the availability of the 12-month interest-free financing option.

Overall, we are very satisfied with the system and installation experience so far.

reviews.title: Best Contract Service (HVAC) Ever
reviews.text:
In the beginning, I was just happy to find someone that could maintain fuel oil furnaces.  I have an old farmhouse.  I contracted Clark for both AC and Heating maintenance, and when they came out they showed me where our dogs had essentially corroded the evaporator coil using it as their bathroom, meaning a new AC system.  After some discussion, I was shown the ultra-high efficiency of the new heat pumps.  Knowing that I would need a new AC system, and pay over $7/gal to fill my 1000 gallon fuel oil tank for the winter, it was a no-brainer.  I am officially total electric now and couldn't be happier.  They also reimbursed me for the compressor start capacitor they installed temporarily to keep me cool until they could be scheduled, which was only about a week lead time - fantastic!

The owner came out to show me my options, absolutely no pressure, and the maintenance and install crew were fantastic.  They even re-routed some of the previously old removed duct work back to where it should be at no cost.  They knew exactly what they were doing.  I can't speak highly enough about the company and employees.  They have this customer for life.

reviews.title: Solid AC, Customer Service not so much
reviews.text:
I've had 3 Amana (Daikin owned) central A/C systems for 10+ years.  Originally purchased because of efficiency ratings, quietness, warranty and dealer recommendation.  They have performed very well through the years. The coil in the air handler of our oldest system developed a leak while at the end of the warranty term and still covered. Unfortunately, it's older refrigerant for which equipment is not easily found, if at all. We were given the option of replacing the coil (if available) with no additional warranty.  

We were very disappointed that we were not offered, or given when asked, any kind of credit for the value warrantied part to use in purchasing the new system.

reviews.title: A heat Pump for me means no Gasseree.
reviews.text: I remodeled our 1993 house in 2019 and the one thing I regretted was simply replacing my gas furnace and AC unit with like, but newer units and not installing a Heat pump.  In the past 6 years the technology has dramatically improved and with the expiration of rebates I decided to get a quiet, high efficiency inverter system from Daikin.  I could not be more pleased with the unit, its performance and the even heat it provides throughout the house.  The certification test had the heat pump cool the house, and again, I was impressed at how effective it was.  I put solar on the roof last year, have a battery backup and decided it was worth the investment now to save the $1,900 a year we were spending on gas.

reviews.title: Daikin - Quiet the Fit
reviews.text: I completely remodeled my current home in 2019.  I put in a new HVAC system, replacing my existing furnace and AC with new units using approved refrigerants.  About a year later I realized I should have put in a heat pump.  I looked at several inverter systems, but the costs were too high and I had just spent $20K for brand new HVAC systems.  I kept and eye on the industry and the Daikin Fit unit kept raising its head.  When recently approached by a local HVAC dealer showing a new net cost below may threshold of pain due to recently expiring state and utility rebates, I decided to move.  in 2025 I installed Solar panels and home battery backup.  Time to cut back on that $2,000 a year going to the gas company.  The Daikin is more compact, quiet and sized for our home.  Despite some installer issues early on, the system was installed, up and running with the promised performance and even heating throughout the house.

reviews.title: Great System

reviews.title: Nicely Done!
reviews.text: We made the decision to upgrade our very old system in September of 2025.  We had a local HVAC Company come out and quote us with both the tradition HVAC System and the Daikin Fit System.  We opted to spend a little more money and go with the Daikin and I am glad we did. We didn't realize how lacking our old system was until the Daikin was up and running.  The outside unit is so quiet we can actually sit in that section of the yard now.  When our Tech went over the thermostat I was a little nervous, but this system does all the work on its own.  You can even set it to detect heating or cooling automatically.  Looking forward to more of the energy saving benefits going forward. Great product!

The variable system allows for even and consistent air flow so there are no sudden blasts of cold air. I definitely appreciate that! Lastly, the almost silent outdoor unit helps make every area of our backyard useable. We no longer have to listen to the annoying starting and stopping sounds of our previous heat pump, which by the way, failed after only 8.5 years! Daikin guarantees their system for 12 years!!!!  The 17 SEER rating should produce lower electric bills for us too!! Thank you, Daikin!

reviews.title: Quiet efficient system and lower electric bills!
reviews.text:
I bought this about a month ago through Mechanical One HVAC in Orlando.  Their service was very timely, professional, and high quality.  The techs who came to do the work were very friendly, helpful, and took the time to answer any questions and explain the system.  It seems to work very well, especially with pulling humidity, as the variable speed inverter systems are known for.  Even with higher temp settings, like 75 or 76, the first floor (where the system is connected) feels very cool.

I also recently received my latest electric bill, and it showed lower than average for the first time.  I'm cautiously optimistic, but I'm hoping this is partially from the efficiency of the new system!  The system is also very, very quiet.  I was a little concerned, because I saw some reviewers said the system was loud.  That hasn't been my experience at all!  I can barely hear it when it runs.  Maybe it'll be louder in the summer, but so far, it's wonderful!

reviews.text: We've only had the system going on two weeks now; but, what I can say is that this system is INSANELY quiet. It's hard to imagine, but the outside unit only makes about as much noise as regular box fan. That's it, no other noise and two people can easily talk at normal volume over it standing right in front of it. I love the dual function thermostat as well, it's very intuitive, easy to manipulate and it's attractive on the wall. I believe the claims about superior humidity control to be valid as well. We live in Houston, and there's no question that the air in our home is dryer which makes the air temp feel more stable between cycles. The extended warranty is also really strong at 12 years. The price point is higher than a single phased system; however, it appears the benefits are going to far outweigh the additional investment.

reviews.title: SMART Thermostat
reviews.text:
I am a senior who has used wood heat and baseboard heaters for decades. Wood is a LOT of work and produces intense heat. Baseboards are inconspicuous, cleaner and can barely keep up. 
In a home purchase a year ago, I have switched from Forced air to a Heat Pump. I am in love. The heat is so even and constant that I no longer put a shawl around my shoulders, take it off, put it back on, take it off...
The first day and on into the first week my hydro usage (KW) dropped by half and I was at half of homes nearby.
And QUIET!   My refridgerator is louder!
The SMART Thermostat is easy for this tech challenged senior. I can check the weather!, schedule 3 - 4 temp 'menus' for each day. Can easily copy a days schedule to any other day. Recirculate the air on a schedule too. 
Looking forward to my first summer. Indoor high temps are more difficult to combat as the cold can be layered up to fight.

reviews.title: Please research Daikin when looking for an HVAC
reviews.text:
I live oceanfront in SC and an HVAC unit has a life expectancy of 5 - 6 years due to salt water.  My HVAC was 6 years old and about to become non-functional before the worst storm in the SC in recent years.  AC Pros contacted me and I eventually purchased a Daikin.  The 12 years warranty was important to me and, for a nominal charge, I purchased the labor warranty.  My Daikin will be covered for virtually 12 years.  

When the Daikin came from the factory, it was configured for the median weather in the South.  No one expected that I would have 8 inches of snow and freezing temperatures.  The Daikin provided heat, but not at the optimal temperatures for the weather.  AC Pros contacted the Daikin area representative and he drove overnight to get to SC to resolve the configuration issues.  The weather was not optimal during his drive.

I highly recommend Daikin.  It is quiet, easy for me to set the temperature either on the thermostat or the app and the service provided was exceptional.  I can’t say enough about my local dealer AC Pros and Daikin.

reviews.title: Enjoying the Fit
reviews.text:
When I was shopping for a heat pump, I wanted reviews from people who had had their equipment for several months. Unfortunately, I’m not that person yet, but here’s what I have to say so far after about one month.

We bought a 60,000 btu 97% Daikin furnace to pair with a 2.5 ton Daikin Fit. This is for an old two-story 1,900 square foot home on the southern border of Michigan. Our installer recommended a cut-off point of 35° before the furnace kicks in. Our electricity is from a dirty mix of mostly natural gas and coal, so I don’t mind having the furnace participate in the heating. I know the heat pump will function much lower than 35, but it loses efficiency, so again, it’s OK when the high-efficiency modulating furnace enters the mix. I read about someone who uses a 40° cutoff because of the price of electricity in his area.

We’re using continuous air circulation at the low fan setting and I’ve noticed how that makes the house warmer than it used be with the old on/off single-stage furnace. The Fit is very quiet, but we are bothered by the sound of furnace blower because of the location of the largest cold-air return vent. Either we will get used to it or have it relocated. 

The system is doing a great job of heating. We’ve had some unusually chilly weather for November, with some temperatures in the mid-20s.

I’ve read online so many complaints about the Daikin thermostat. I was expecting the worst when I had to give up using my ecobee, but I don’t understand the complaints. I think it’s a more-than-adequate thermostat. I think it reads a little warm. I turned off the display and just tap it to bring it alive and that might have helped a little. Maybe it’s a little variable. Sometimes it matches a thermometer placed on top of it and sometimes it doesn’t. Nevertheless, I’m not complaining about the thermostat.

reviews.title: Good system, installer issues
reviews.text:
I had a Daikin DH6VSA4810 heat pump with a DFVE48DP1300 air handler and Daikin One+ thermostat installed in Orlando, FL at the beginning of September. The equipment itself is strong, but the installation process caused problems.  

At first, the system couldn’t dehumidify properly — even with a separate dehumidifier running, indoor humidity stayed around 60%. Later I discovered multiple leaks around the air handler and plenums, and the installer hadn’t even pulled the required mechanical permit until I caught it.  

Once those leaks were sealed, performance improved dramatically. Now, without a dehumidifier, humidity stays around 57% during the day and drops lower at night. The system works as it should — but homeowners should make sure their installer does the job right.

reviews.title: Awesome Daikin HVAC R32 System!!
reviews.text: My AC went out and evaporator coil was leaking old R401A refrigerant so it made sense to upgrade the coil to R32. I got 3 more estimates and Cory had a good presentation on the superior Daikin HVACs with their DC inverter variable speed systems (super quiet at the furnace and outside condenser) that are most energy efficient at around SEER2 17 and humidity control along with better 5” dual filters. Also included a 12 year parts and labor transferable warranty that doesn’t require a yearly maintenance program which all other estimates required which saves around $250 a year ( $3000 in 12 years). They installed it flawlessly and efficiently and their crew all educated and could communicate with me nicely. Mostly impressed with the overall cost, they were most flexible and helped me get a great deal over the other estimates. I will definitely refer Casteel to anyone who needs an upgraded HVAC system. Daikin is the only system that uses the superior R32 refrigerant so be aware of that. R454B is the newest that came out in Jan 2025 so really not tested as much and didn’t perform as well as R32 so I’m really happy with my purchase!

reviews.title: Really cools now!
reviews.text: Well, after much wrangling, Casteel Heating & AC finally sent out a technician that was competent!  After your 2 & 1/2 half ton unit fried its control board in July 2024 and a year’s worth of hot nights; Casteel replaced it with a 3 ton unit in late summer 2025.  Still would not cool the second floor!  I had told Casteel many times that they needed to test the original refrigerant hoses between the outside compressor and the inside evaporator coil.  Many times Casteel assured me they had pressure tested the hoses.  In 7, 2025 their competent tech found that the hoses repeatedly lost refrigerant, causing my problem.  Casteel then stepped up and replaced both hoses with larger sizes!  Guess what, your Daikin system holds my second floor at 72 degrees on 92 degrees days!  So, after more than a year of suspecting Daikin inefficiency, I find the issue was Casteel’s incompetence ALL THE WHILE!

reviews.title: Exceptional Performance from Daikin's Advanced A/C
reviews.text:
As a homeowner in South Florida, I recently upgraded my home's cooling system with Daikin's high-efficiency units – specifically the DCVSS2410, DC6VSS3610, DFVE24BP1300, and DFVE36CP1300 models – and the results have been nothing short of transformative. Daikin has truly outdone themselves with these innovative systems, delivering superior comfort and energy savings that have exceeded my expectations.

These units have effectively reduced the humidity levels in my home, allowing me to set the thermostat several degrees warmer than with my old, outdated system without any discomfort. The dehumidification capabilities are outstanding, creating a consistently pleasant indoor environment even during the hottest, most humid months. All of this comes with significant savings on my electrical bill – I've noticed a marked decrease in energy consumption right from the first month, thanks to Daikin's efficient design and advanced technology.

Additionally, the ability to connect the thermostats to my smart home network has provided seamless integration with other smart devices, further enhancing the functionality of the system from daytime to nighttime, as well as when the home is occupied or not. This smart connectivity allows for automated adjustments based on schedules, occupancy, and even voice commands, making the whole setup incredibly convenient and efficient.

The build quality and reliability of these models shine through in their quiet operation and precise climate control. Daikin's commitment to innovation is evident in how seamlessly these units handle variable-speed performance and smart features that optimize cooling based on real-time needs.

I highly recommend Daikin for anyone looking to invest in top-tier HVAC solutions. Their products not only enhance home comfort but also promote energy efficiency and long-term savings. If you're in the market for a new A/C system, Daikin is a brand you can trust – five stars for performance and value!

I cannot express how greatly improved my cooling system is after getting a Daikin Fit installed. We went from a Carrier 3.5 ton to the Daikin Fit 4 ton. I live in South Fl and we have humidity most of the year. What I didn't appreciate in the old unit was the struggles it would have with said humidity. The Fit takes care of that easily. The exact same temperature with the old unit feels like a whole other world with the Fit. We went from 42-48% humidity to 36-40%. Every visitor we had since installation has been shocked at the difference it makes. Everything else about the unit just just icing on the cake. DC motor is less stressful on the energy bill, the adjusting speed of the fan handles daytime temp changes easily, and the app is so dang cool. I don't have to go up and downstairs all day just to see if it's running. 

This unit has really changed my perspective on what basic necessities a home should have. If I move it's not a question what I'm installing in the next house, I'm a fan for life. Bravo team Daikin, keep up the good work.

Purchased in October 2024 heat pump did an excellent job in keeping us warm through all the winter months.

Service rep was scheduled same week at a day convenient to us. tech diagnosed a short in the senser wiring and ordered the relevant parts. Once the parts were installed more service codes popped up!
the tech contacted the technical service office and after extensive testing Daikin stood by their warranty and authorized the replacement of the outdoor unit. as a plus Daikin restarted the 12-year warranty at the date of the replacement.  If it hadn't been for the Service Message, we might not have noticed the problem until our Gas Bill for the increased backup energy was mailed.
I've always said you can tell how good a company, and their products are by how you are treated when a problem occurs.  I can now unequivocally say Dakin and their installer Greenwood are the best!

reviews.title: Quiet and it DOES qualify for 2k tax credit
reviews.text:
Purchased the fit 16.2:Seer2 . Condenser 4 ton and air handler 5 ton. Love everything about the system but having issues with the Daikin one thermostat. Set the air no problem but it does not draw out the humidity like my old R22 trane did . This concerns me especially in summer when we travel .
We reside in Florida. 
I was assured by using the 5 ton Air handler that it would adapt to the 4 ton condenser and be able to draw out the humidity. 
Love the 12 year warranty on the condenser the AH the compressor  thermostat and labor Can't be beat. 
Love the features of the inverter driven compressor and variable two speed fan. Would have given the rating a 5 star had it not been for the humidity issue. The installer came twice to tweak the thermostat but not sure what he did won't cost me dearly in the summer months. He set the control to over cool meaning if humidity doesn't drop below 60 % the set temperature will continue cooling to more that 5 degrees of the desired temperature just to draw out the humidity. Seems counter productive to efficiency.

reviews.title: Extremely Impressed
reviews.text: We were flooded by hurricane Milton, which killed our 20 year old heat pump.  Remediation of the home was paramount and getting the house back under air was very important.  Overall, I am very impressed that Polar Bear Cooling and Heating responded quickly to assess my request for a replacement system, answer my questions promptly, and schedule my installation within 1 week of signing the paperwork to proceed with the installation.  This system comes with a 12 years parts AND Labor warranty, which was a big plus over other quotes I obtained.  The price is on the higher side but the quick turnaround on installation sealed the deal.  Polar Bear installation technicians, Vlad and Elijah, arrived promptly on the day of install.  We walked through the assessment of the equipment, locations, and discussed any changes needed to complete the new Daikin Fit system installation.   Both men were personable, polite, kept me informed of what they were doing and why, and performed their work in a professional and diligent manner.  After the installation was complete and the system running properly, Vlad walked me through the new WiFi thermostat and how to link the Daikin One Home app to my phone and how to program the system for our needs.  Of particular note was the next day when the County Inspector arrived to look over the installation and sign off on the permit.  His exact words were “This look absolutely great and was installed perfectly.”  He was very impressed with the work that Vlad and Elijah did on this installation.  We talked about how quiet this system is compared to our older heat pump.  He mentioned that this is the new, up and coming technology (inverter compressor) of the future.    I have noticed too, that this system moves more air throughout our home than the older system.  The job site was cleaned up well and I am pleased to highly recommend Polar Bear Cooling and Heating to others looking for a quote.  Research the Daikin Fit system to compare with other traditional systems and see if it’s right for you.

reviews.title: Best AC unit we have owned!
reviews.text: We had a complete new Daikin AC system installed about three weeks ago, after our 17+ year old air handler went out. We made the decision to upgrade and replace for a complete new system, and we are certainly glad we did! The variable speed system is super quiet and most efficient. The humidity in this central Florida home is way down! Even the humidity in our attic has dropped! The house stays cooled and the grade 11 filter plus the UV lights have reduced dust throughout the house. We have not yet received a comparison electric bill with the new system, but I am anticipating a savings. This is not the cheapest choice for us, but definitely worth the investment in our 32 year old home. We had this built in 1992 and had replaced the air handler twice and the heat pump once. We are super pleased with the product and with the dealer, Hawkins Service Company, who helped us make this choice. The only advice I would offer is that the compressor really blows out a ton of heat. A diverter would offer as a good option for customers. We opted to place a louvered diverting screen to dissipate the warm air from off of our plants. By far, this unit is well worth the investment if you plan on staying in your home for years to come, as we do.

reviews.title: Quiet, Efficient and Working like a Charm
reviews.text:
I’ve been dealing with cooling issues on the second floor of my home for over six months. Multiple technicians came out, cleaned coils, and performed troubleshooting, but nothing seemed to help. I was certain that the original 2-ton heat pump was too small for the job, even though the technician and company assured me it was the right size._x000D_
_x000D_
After some research and speaking to other homeowners, I decided to upgrade to a 2.5-ton unit based on the recommendation of another technician. While I originally thought of going with a 3-ton unit, I’m happy to report that the 2.5-ton heat pump has been working amazingly well for the past 10 days. Even with outdoor temperatures hitting 90°F and above, my second floor stays at a comfortable 70°F, exactly where I want it._x000D_
_x000D_
This new system is not only quiet but also very efficient, maintaining a consistent temperature throughout my home. _x000D_
_x000D_
After further verification, I’d recommend that other homeowners consider going with a 3-ton or even 3.5-ton unit, as I’ve confirmed this doesn’t require duct resizing or major modifications. I’ve spoken to homeowners who installed 4-ton units over seven years ago and have had no issues since but this was after I had mine installed._x000D_
_x000D_
I regret not going with the larger unit sooner, but I’m extremely pleased with the performance so far. I’m hoping this system continues to operate at this level for years to come!

After giving me some background information including that Daikin was the largest manufacturer of HVAC systems in the world, I thought that was just a boast to offer credibility. Then I did some research, and it was true. Another thing the tech said was that it was the quietest compressor system he had ever known. After the system was installed, I walked out to the compressor, and I couldn't tell it was running until I walked over to feel the air from the cooling fan. In the first few days, we noticed that our house was cooler, and the upstairs was as cool as the downstairs with a single unit cooling the whole house. I will recommend a Daikin to anyone looking to replace their HVAC systems.

reviews.title: Ferrari of Daikin?
reviews.text:
I have not had my new unit long enough to speak about actual quality or longevity, but I can briefly explain why I chose to purchase the most expensive Daikin solution offered by my dealer._x000D_
The Daikin FIT is the first modern air conditioning system I have ever seen. By using inverter technology to provide fully proportional control of all aspects of the system (air handler, compressor, expansion valve, etc.) you can ensure your system will likely live longer by not constantly banging on/off all the time. Instead, it can enter a lower-power steady state which is responsive to the actual conditions inside your house by leveraging the bi-directional communication with the thermostat. The reactivity of your system will reflect the real-time needs of your home. Anyway, as an engineer, it made a ton of sense to me. The fact that it is quieter, more efficient and generally "cooler" is a bonus. I bought the system for the perceived longevity of the system as a whole, as I was replacing a troublesome Trane that only lasted 6 years.

reviews.title: A heat pump to beat all heat pumps
reviews.text:
When shopping for an HVAC contractor it is imperative that a homeowner educate themselves in advance. Learn about the different types of equipment, the benefits of each, costs, efficiency, lifespan, warranties, and maybe most importantly is your distribution of conditioned air in your living space. Of course by that I am referring to ductwork and how air moves throughout your space. Great airflow is the beginning of comfort, finding someone who understands that is paramount._x000D_
_x000D_
Earlier this week, not a moment too soon given the extreme heat we are facing in the Susquehanna Valley, we had a Daikin Fit 2 ton heat pump installed at our home. This system is a fully variable speed modulating/communicating system. This system replaces a nearly 30 year old oil forced air furnace and dinosaur of a central AC. No more $1500.00 oil bills at the beginning of the heating season, no more smells of exhaust and carbon monoxide alarms going off on windy days, no more uncertainty of annual costs…just clean, reliable, quiet, energy efficient heating and cooling._x000D_
_x000D_
Words/phrases like wow, I never thought, I’ve never been so comfortable, and I can’t hear it come to mind when speaking about this new system. To say we are impressed or pleased is a gross under-representation of how happy we are. The humidity in the home is finally under control. The temperature is even in every room. No more noisy floor fans, obnoxious window units, and wildly different temperatures room to room. No more humidifiers sitting around the house in the winter to clean and listen to. This new system does it all, literally everything. A simple command to Alexa, a quick swipe on your smart phone, or a touch of the Daikin One+ thermostat and our adjustments have been made from anywhere in the world where there is an internet connection. A gentle blue glow on the wall indicates the system is actively cooling the home while an orange glow signifies heating is in progress._x000D_
_x000D_
Jeff, Levi, and the distinguished installers and designers at Warner made it possible. After having other companies quote as any responsible homeowner would do, it was clear within minutes that these were the folks for the job. They were early to their appointment, had clean vehicles, professional, and spelled out exactly what to expect from start to finish. They even got our system installed ahead of schedule. Day one was crazy awesome. The old junk was removed and hauled away and existing duct modifications began. Day two wrapped up the new design changes, the overwhelming remainder of the install, wiring, and other checks. Day three only lasted four hours and consisted of commissioning and startup of the new system. We literally went from old, inefficient, and outdated to modern, sleek, and amazing in about 20-24 hours of total work._x000D_
_x000D_
Looking back, our biggest regret is waiting so long. For years we dealt with what we had because we didn’t realize we could do this and actually afford it. Call Warner for your home comfort needs, ask about the Daikin Fit for your home, and begin your journey to being part of the Warner family and comfort exceeding your expectations._x000D_
_x000D_
We even capture our condensate water to water our plants with! A win for us and the environment we cherish.

reviews.title: Pretty awesome but not perfect yet
reviews.text:
Very awesome product. Works like a charm for 3 weeks of use so far. I’d like to point out the imperfections since those are everyone cares about:_x000D_
_x000D_
1. The Daikin One Touch control panel is a piece of trash. It’s really difficult to find another laggy touch screen control in 2024. To make things worse, it uses data wires for proprietary protocols, thus we can’t replace it with things like Nest._x000D_
_x000D_
2. The air handler does have flow control for air blowing out, but not for the returns. So if your air handler is very close to one return and the space isn’t enough to use longer duct, airflow for the returns will be very imbalanced. Especially when system is under lower load, you mostly would feel only one return is working if the duct for the other is 3x longer._x000D_
_x000D_
Besides above, it’s still an awesome heat pump system.

reviews.title: Seamless
reviews.text:
We replaced our 27 year old 2 3 ton conventional HVAC with gas heating with 2 3 ton Daikin Fit units for a total of 6 tons for 3000 sq ft home -- one of the biggest if not the biggest reason to go with an all electric heat pump HVAC is because of the unfolding Climate Crisis...we wanted to do our part and every bit helps -- the installer did an amazing job putting in these great units -- the results: WELCOME TO FUTURE! The operation of the Daikin Fits in our home can only be described as seamless. Seamless in terms of integration with the Daikin App as well as we have never experienced the kind of seamless wall to wall floor to ceiling heating and air conditioning coverage throughout our home as we do now...just amazing. _x000D_
_x000D_
NOTE: Daikin needs to figure out how to get the Daikin Fit to qualify for the Fed 2K rebate for switching from conventional HVAC to heat pump -- almost a deal killer, yet as per my review; still very happy to have chosen Daikin.

reviews.title: Technology at it's finest
reviews.text: I just built a new house and installed the Daikin Variable Speed unit. This will continually run at a very low rpm to maintain temps or a high rpm to cool down quickly. This is what you want instead of the all on until reaching temp or all off when the temp is reached. This is what wears out your unit. This Daikin product is amazing at maintaining set temperature and this is a centrifugal motor that runs at the necessary RPM. Not any more or any less. The unit is 1/2 the size of a conventional unit and is super quiet. This is the newest Air Conditioning technology available. I love it. Electric bills are tiny as the Daikin unit is way more efficient vs what you are currently using.

reviews.title: DZ6VS - quiet - great thermostat - best warranty
reviews.text: My air conditioner broke during a central California heat wave.  I did a lot of research for a replacement split system looking for best, most reliable, lowest decibel rating, max SEER2, and >97% AFUE.  Not happy with California ultra low NOx standards and resulting low AFUE not eligible for rebate as well as potential for noise and repair.  Got a visit from my brand servicer and an email quote a day later, but I had lots of follow up questions and install would be a week out.  Asked for bid from next best, but they had merged with a different but large dealer, Lee’s.  Lee’s contact came out the next day, was able to answer my very long list of questions on the spot, do a load calculation, make a recommendation, provide a quote and schedule installation the next day.  Done!  Its been in for a day.  I was negative against a heat pump and electricity for heat in winter, I wanted to have a gas option.  But, 12 year warranty and quiet running won. We’ll see about winter warmth and efficiency when it gets here.  I like the steady airflow, very quiet, and the thermostat is the best.  It looks nice, is easy to use and has lots and lots of options for creating what you want.  I also like a company that has it together and just gets the job done.  Daikin and Lee’s are both excellent in that regard.  And, Lee’s thoughtfully brought two portable coolers while technicians were in and out on a very hot day.

reviews.title: SO FAR VERY GOOD
reviews.text:
Our new Daikin heat pump and furnace were installed last week by AB May in the Kansas City area.  We are very satisfied with the install.  The crew was here by 8 AM and the project was completed by 4 PM.  The new Daikin unit looks great.  The a/c cools wonderfully.  Of course, in May we have not operated the furnace yet.  I can say that the outside unit is far quieter than our old unit.  The unit sits right outside our bedroom window and it is impossible to hear it when operational.  The old unit was very noisy on start up and during operation and would often awaken us during start up.  They truly got this part right.  We did have some issues with setting the Daikin thermostat.  The unit wanted to keep running until the temperature was 4 degrees cooler than what it was set at.  This range of tolerance was not acceptable.  We called AB May and they immediately came out and replaced the thermostat.  This appears to have corrected the problem. While it is too early in use to make a full evaluation we can say that the AB May install exceeded our expectation.  The Daikin unit appears to be a great addition to our home. I am confident that it will save energy versus our old unit. The system we purchased came with a 12 year warranty so I feel this  gives us the comfort of knowing that our heating and cooling system will by reliable for years to come.  We are very satisfied customers at this point. _x000D_
Dan and Anne W

reviews.title: So far, very happy
reviews.text: We’just got this installed a couple of weeks ago, but so fat we are very happy. It’s too early to comment on energy savings. It’s springtime in Massachusetts, so we’ve had days that needed AC and days we needed heat. Both worked great! The unit is very very quiet, inside and outside the home. I was very resistant to  having a digital thermostat but I love it. Control it online or by the digital keypad on the wall.  We kept our old boiler for very cold days, and I’m not sure how/when it will switch over… will have to see next winter. I also like the features of continuous fan to circulate air, levels of fan speed (low, medium, high), seeing indoor and outdoor conditions from the handsome keypad.  Important note- this system is not like traditional central air in the way that central air cools a room fast. This takes time to slowly start blowing and then very slowly start cooling (I’m estimating 1/2 hour before I started to feel a difference in the room). I think that’s why I’m supposed to let the thermostat do the temperature control. Once I get used to that I’m sure it will be fine.  I can’t wait to see my next gas/electric bill.

reviews.text:
We installed a 3.5T Daikin Fit heat pump, air-handler, and premium in-line air cleaner to replace our 25yo gas furnace and are thrilled that we did. Compared to our ancient gas furnace, the Daikin Fit is whisper quiet, inside and outside. I was initially skeptical of the Daikin phone app as a gimmick, it turns out to be very useful and intuitive, and now my main interface to the system in lieu of the Daikin thermostat, which is also pretty cool!  _x000D_
_x000D_
While the Daikin Fit was not the cheapest system quote we got, it was far below the most expensive. I'm convinced that if you're in the market to replace your HVAC, the Daikin Fit is both a great economic value as well as highly efficient ecological solution, and if your region offers heat pump incentives and/or tax credits, the Fit is an even more compelling solution._x000D_
_x000D_
Our dealer/installer, A1 Heating & Cooling, was refreshingly professional, courteous, and thorough (even though they don't show up as a Daikin dealer for my zip code on Daikin's website...). I already have several neighbors now considering the Daikin Fit heat pump to replace their old gas furnaces.

reviews.text:
So it's been almost a week since this system was installed. The verdict is still out on how satisfied I am with the system. I've had ongoing outlying issues for many years with multiple systems that I'm hoping this will remedy - extreme house humidity, spotty operation of previous new system, compressor issues, complete shutdowns - with the biggest issue being humidity in my FL home._x000D_
Pros: Extremely, extremely quiet, very small condenser footprint, quiet air handler, hopefully lower cost_x000D_
_x000D_
Cons: the "smart" thermostat is the weakest point. The wheel on it is useless. There is very little literature that come with the unit that explains the BEST way to program it for various issues. Trying to use YouTube (but shouldn't have to). The touch screen is ridiculously small for a man's fingers to operate. There are a wide wide of functions to navigate through in order to address specific programming and operational goals. The temperature setting "range" is difficult to understand for programming a specific operational goal._x000D_
_x000D_
Over time - I'm curious to see the cost savings and whether it will really Dehumidify as well as they advertise.

reviews.title: Love my Daikin!
reviews.text: I recently bought my Daikin a few weeks ago and so far everything is running smoothly.  I am so surprised at how quiet the unit is both outside and the air handler inside.  I live in southwest Florida and it has been extremely hot this summer.  I have the thermostat set at 75 degrees Fahrenheit and it pretty much stays there all day.  It never seems to struggle to keep up with the set temperature.  It is also really good at keeping the humidity low in the house.  The system does exactly what the company states: the motor simply ramps up when it needs to cool and slows down once the house has cooled to its set temperature.  It’s pretty cool how the system works!  I love how the digital thermostat tells you what the system is doing.  For example: it may say something like “overcooling to dehumidify”, or “cooling to 75”.  I haven’t had the system long enough to see what sort of savings I will see on my electric bill but I’m sure I will see some sort of savings on my electricity.  Another great thing about Daikin is, when my AC company installed my unit the fan in the condenser unit must have been off balance and it scratched my inside cover a little bit.  Daikin replaced not only the scratched cover but also the fan as a precaution.  There were no questions asked.  They just simply replaced it.  I highly recommend a Daikin to anyone who is in need of a new AC system.  My purchase came with a 12 year parts and labor warranty.  Who can beat that?  So far I am pleased with my unit.

Any actual issues with the system were from the install. The installers didn't seal the air plenum to the coils, nor did they seal the furnace with the air handler. Once those issues are corrected, I'm sure this would be considered a -star system. I haven't had the system long enough to judge the efficiency or the overall performance, but I have faith the system will prove itself worthy of every cent spent on it._x000D_

reviews.text: We went with the 17-18 SEER unit for more energy efficiency.  It is a two cycle system so rather than the cold/hot you get with other systems its purpose is to keep the temperature steady.  So far though we cannot get the humidity lower than about 68% even though the manufacturer optimum level is about 40-50%.  In addition we have to keep the temperature lower than we did before or it is too hot.  We used to keep it at 74 during the day for our 4 dogs but now we have to keep it at 70.  I have not received an electric bill yet so I do not know if this is going to save or cost me money at this points.  This is a second air conditioner in the other end of our house which is an area that does not get much use.  Our dogs are kenneled in a room down there during the day and our washer/dryer is there. Our old unit was over 23 years old but it kept this area cooler.  At this point I am not sure if we just need to get used to the different type of system or if it was not a good choice for us.

reviews.title: Daikin Fit is the future!

Daikin has packed all the advanced features of a mini split into a ducted unit that replaced our furnace, heat pumps are the way of the future and looking forward to doing our part to protect the environment. We paired our fit with the premium MERV 15 air filter and the One thermostat. I cannot say enough about this unit, quite, efficient, smart; my only gripe would be hoping they had a bit of a higher SEER rating... but those ratings can be a bit deceiving as they rate the unit on full blast and these units rarely ever work that way. I should mention we also now have 3 other Daikin mini splits ;)

reviews.title: Buy Once, Buy Right!
reviews.text: I stumbled upon the Daikin Fit in my search for a complete new system to replace my old 12 year old heat pump unit that was costing me $$$$ to maintain.  My criteria was performance, efficiency, reliability, and warranty.  We have been without a functioning AC for the spring months while I meticulously researched looking for the best bang for my hard earned $.  The Daikin Fit system paired with a Daikin air handler and Daikin One thermostat were just the right...fit.  Performance, efficiency, and warranty, with a true inverter that typically only comes with much more expensive systems.  Reliability?  Time will tell, though it gives me comfort to know that Daikin is an international well known company that backs the FIT model with a 12 year warranty.  12 years! I don't know of another company that has such a stout warranty.  My FIT system is installed, its quiet, keeps me wonderfully cool in the Texas heat, and i expect it to be an energy miser. When it came time to replace the unit in my home, I immediately turned to Daikin for the job. This unit is probably overkill for the average homeowner but is by far the best bang for your buck on the market. It is a feature packed system that is extremely energy efficient. The only knock on this system is that you have to have the Daikin thermostat in order to take full advantage of all of the features of this system. It won't operate to its full potential with any other t-stat. Unfortunately, the daikin stat and app leave a lot to be desired in the looks department and the app is a little clunky. It gets the job done though, and I have no complaints thus far.  Despite the thermostat shortcomings, this is still an overall 5 star system that Daikin stands behind with an extremely generous warranty. You can't go wrong here.

reviews.title: Daikin Fit is a big (but quiet) hit!
reviews.text: We got our Daikin Fit system with a heat pump, multi-position and multi-speed gas furnace, and the Daikin One+ thermostat installed just right in time before the first heat wave here in the West. The system is wonderful and wonderfully quiet. We have to have our condenser on the patio and can have the compressor running while we're still being able to sit outside, talk, and enjoy a summer day on the balcony--it is just whispering quiet! While other A/C systems would continuously start and stop with a loud rattle, the inverter system just runs at the required power and blows the air with the furnace fan running on low--but consistently. The system does a great job in keeping the set temperature (without any fluctuation), which provides a completely different comfort level compared to classic systems. We also love that we can run the fan to circulate air at different speeds. The heat pump will help us to safe a lot on gas during milder winter days while the gas furnace completes the system to a dual fuel system. We had to take off one star due to the Daikin One+ thermostat, as the user interface has many issues. Our solution is not to use the dial or wait for it waking up from screen saver mode (it just doesn't work) and use the smartphone app at all times. The thermostat is basically just the (expensive) computer that runs the whole system. We wished though there were better screen savers, a working wake function, and a more responsive temperature dial. Hopefully software updates will fix all the issues with the Daikin One+ thermostat which provides great control and is clearly the brain of the Daikin Fit system.

We bought the system and it is working fine. Only complain we have is that there are no quick answers reference about using the Digital WiFi thermostat. We spent thousands of dollars and did not even receive a printed manual how to use the thermostat. Tutorial videos are helpful but not practical to us to use.

reviews.title: Thermostat Whoas
reviews.text: I purchased this system about 3 weeks ago. The cooling qualities of this system are outstanding, but I have had problems with the thermostat from the first day it was installed. It was reading the true temperature of the inside environment of my home correctly. I have an open floor plan home and when I returned from an outing, the thermometer in the living room read 75 degrees and it felt like it. But the thermostat read 69 degrees. I lowered the thermostat to 65 degrees and the house cooled within minutes. I called for service and 2 days later the tech arrives and recalibrated the thermostat which really wasn’t accepting the input, so the tech ordered a new one. 1 week later the new on arrived (I hope not refurbished) and out of the box it read within 2 degrees of the thermometer I have in my home, which I found to be acceptable. Everything works fine but now I fine the blue light which indicates the mode the system is in only works intermittently, whereas the old one came on every time the system cycled on. This may sound petty, but when you pay that much for a system you should get the performance you paid for. Overall the system works great, and I can’t wait to see the affect it will have on my energy bill.

reviews.title: Much quieter than previous A/C
reviews.text:
I just got this a few weeks ago when my old HVAC failed. So far it is much quieter than my old unit (since my outside unit is near my bedroom window, this is a big plus) and it keeps the house temperature very stable and comfortable._x000D_
_x000D_
Since this is a variable speed unit, it runs at low speed and stays on most of the time. (My installer warned me ahead of time that this is normal.) Again, this also means that it is quieter in operation. When it is running on low, I have to really listen to hear it, even when the house is quiet. Since it rarely goes to high speed, it doesn't send out strong currents of cold air. The cool air comes out much more gently. But since it runs so much of the time, it sets up a near-constant gentle air circulation through the house, so there aren't hot and cool areas._x000D_
_x000D_
I am expecting/hoping for big energy savings, but my old unit died at the beginning of fall. My latest power bill was a LOT lower, but the weather wasn't consistently hot all month, either. I won't be able to make a fair comparison on energy use until next summer._x000D_
_x000D_
Having a touchscreen thermostat and being able to control the unit from my smartphone is nice, but that was not a selling point for me. _x000D_
_x000D_
However, the touchscreen thermostat does allow for one feature I have long wanted: in spring and fall weather swings are frequent and sometimes sudden. With this thermostat I can set a temperature range for the house. If the inside temperature falls below the range, the system will automatically heat. If the inside temperature goes above the range the system will automatically cool. So I can set the thermostat and never have to worry about the house being excessively hot or cold no matter what the weather does. _x000D_
_x000D_
This system also seems to do a better job of controlling the humidity than my A/C did. Living in Florida, a.k.a., the "Sauna State," that's a big advantage._x000D_
_x000D_
I like the 12 year warranty on parts, and sincerely hope that I never have to use it!
